newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Wednesday's interbank session marginally firmer on the U.S. dollar but was quoted easier against sterling, the mark and the rand, dealers said.

"The (local) dollar strengthened to 11.2785/2885 against the U.S. dollar before the (central) Reserve Bank came in to mop up almost U.S.$5 million from the market," a dealer said, adding that most of the money came from the on-going annual tobacco sales, a major foreign currency earner for the southern African country.
The central bank's intervention brought the local unit down to close at 11.2925/3025, but this was still a slight gain over late Tuesday's 11.2950/3050.
The Zimbabwe dollar however ended the day weaker at 18.6350/6600 from 18.5600/5800 versus sterling, at 6.6675/6755 from 6.6400/6600 against the mark and at 2.5320/55 on the rand from 2.5300/5400.
